summary: EDENOR filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 earnings release. The filing reports financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026, including revenues, EBITDA, and operational highlights under its tariff review framework. It also announces a webcast to discuss results and provides standard financial metrics. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
